conclusion.correctness: The fixed-length guide implementation passed independent finite-state balance tests, analytic sphere/depletion reference checks, and focused integration/regression tests. This supports the tested implementation and limits; it is not a proof of the floating-point sampler.
conclusion.efficiency: The frozen protein pilot shows cheap rejection can reduce depletion work, but no demonstrated learned cooperative docking or contact-mixing speedup. Guide length 16 increases cost and mostly proposes unfavorable detachments.
conclusion.thermodynamics: Unresolved. Frozen conditional phase probes and analytic-sphere checks establish neither protein equilibrium weights nor native assembly/stability.

guide_validation.scope_note: The existing 65-theorem Lean audit was reused; no additional guide-specific theorem was added. Concrete guide reversibility is supported by the mathematical argument plus executable tests.
guide_validation.post_test_change: Initial guide-density CPU timing accounting changed after these tests; no guide score, proposal, RNG or physical kernel change.

physical_reference_validation.interval_method: Diagnostic Student t(df=3,0.975) * max(pooled independent-block SE, between-stream SE), using four independently seeded streams; approximate, not a convergence guarantee. Independent importance reference uses normal 1.96*SE.

protein_pilot.scope: Frozen whole-system phase transitions, not equilibrium trajectories, contact ESS, assembly stability, or physical kinetics.

protocol.phase_reset: Every fixed-duration cluster phase starts at its declared frozen full-system configuration. It is not a continued assembly trajectory.
protocol.schedule: No ordinary single-body, GCA, or center-shift updates between reset probes.
protocol.rng: SHA256 named streams paired across arms; independent population, phase and preparation labels; arm omitted.
protocol.replay_checks: Every old/retained event pose; independent proposed gained/lost cut edges; final pose equality and contact graph equality to a full rebuild.
protocol.timing: Sampler CPU includes phase contact-graph construction and record collection; post-hoc replay/geometry and JSON output are timed separately. Shape/model setup excluded.

interpretation_limits: The attachment seen in guide lengths 1 and 4 is the same paired realization, not two independent successes. It originated in a defensive uniform inner draw.
No accepted detachment or completed contact exchange occurred in any arm. Zero observations do not establish zero equilibrium probability.
The stalled conditional acceptance sum near 0.334 is dominated by two weak-contact detachment proposals; neither was accepted.
Accepted-move throughput, isolated conditional proposals and this short frozen-state pilot are not contact ESS or a thermodynamic conclusion.
